[[File:LukeHand.png|thumb|250px|Luke's L-hand 980 after being modified by an electodriver]]
'''Electrodrivers''',<ref name="ROTSTVD">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> also known as '''Electro-drivers'''<ref name="ROTSN">[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|''Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith'' novelization]]</ref> or '''Electro-drivens''', were advanced mechanical components that functioned like the simpler piston. Electrodrivers were used in [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] prosthetics, such as [[Mechno-arm/Legends|mechno-arms]], and worked in conjunction with [[Servomotor/Legends|servomotors]].<ref name="ROTSTVD" />
